## Objective

A human owner can end one or several active runs as `superseded`, naming a successor, or as `abandoned`, giving a reason, through one reviewed decision. Each ended run keeps all of its artefacts and history, carries the decision as a sealed and attributable receipt, disappears from the active lists of every AGDF reader and stays readable as history with its outcome and reason. The closure is final.

## Mode/Slice Decision

- decision: structured_delivery
- required_next_gate: PRD
- scope_reason: persistence_migration_depth. The closure is an irreversible lifecycle transition of the sealed canonical run record with a new receipt kind; further decisive triggers are an authority boundary (the human confirmation on the MCP path must not be confirmable by the agent) and an external contract (new public CLI command and MCP operation shared by four hosts). quick_task and verified_change are ineligible because CLI, persistence and authority behavior change. Rejected alternative: structured_slice, because authority_boundary, full_depth_impacts_absent and migration_propagation_bounded fail.
- evidence: This review (.agdf/control/artefacts/run-lifecycle-close-20261028-01/BROWNFIELD_REVIEW.md); approved UR revision 3; run-steps.js:360-406; run-command-contract.js:55,63; run-operations.js:8,24; run-recovery.js:17-30; run-backlog-writer.js:24-25.
